column1: # THE READING LIST — spectra already fitted whose defects were not read.
# Register 1590. For each species below the IONISATION ENERGY IS MEASURED,
# which means a Rydberg series WAS fitted. The quantum defect is the OTHER
# output of that same fit — the series limit and the offset come together.
# So these are not experiments to perform. They are readings not taken.
# Every one is UNBOUNDED in the index: the nucleus survives, nature made the
# element, the series resolves below ng, an analysis exists at that charge,
# and the core has a single parent. Nothing stands in the way.
# Source for the ionisation energies: LADDER-K-Kr.tsv, quality flag M.
# The defects must come from the ORIGINAL series fit, not from the IE alone —
# an IE gives only the GROUND-state defect, and register 1546 established
# that is a different quantity from the asymptotic one the index holds.
# EXTENDED at register 1593 with 34 NEUTRALS from IE-neutral-all.tsv,
# all outside the K-Kr ladder's window and all with a MEASURED first
# ionisation energy. Same claim as the rest: the series was fitted, the
# defect is the other output of that fit, the reading was not taken.
